input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor for service delivery, reinforced by Section 15.1 (no sale, advertising use, data combination or model training without our consent). Section 14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further-assurance obligations. Section 14.3 leaves Vendor with its pre-existing Vendor Technology but applies the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including rights to modify and create derivative works) to any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable, and requires pre-delivery identification of such material. Section 14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument setting out exploitation rights, and feedback is voluntary with no assignment of Customer rights. Nothing elsewhere assigns our IP or data to Vendor.
